notes.title: Competitive multipayer + cooperative multiplayer + Free demo
notes.notes:
We are launching the competitive multiplayer of 2.4 or 8 players that adds to the possibility of playing the campaign mode in cooperative multiplayer mode.

We also released a free demo on both Steam and Oculus Quest.

Enjoy it!

notes.title: Pangman update 1
notes.notes:
- When you have the hook in your hand it is now facing forward. Which makes its use much more intuitive.
- Improvements in cooperative multiplayer
- Various improvements to the messages that guide the player on how to make better use of slow time and hooks.
- Minor bug fixes.
